item.title: Judge blocks additional citizenship provisions in latest setback to Trump's election executive order
item.description: A judge permanently blocked two provisions of the executive order that sought to impose proof-of-citizenship rules.

item.title: Coast Guard suspends search for people missing from fishing vessel that sank off Massachusetts
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard has announced that the search for survivors on a commercial fishing vessel that sank off the coast of Massachusetts with seven aboard has been suspended.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara 'changed how so many of us understand comedy and humanity'
item.description: Catherine O'Hara was never afraid to go big. Known for roles in "Schitt's Creek," "Beetlejuice," and "Home Alone," she made her lines and characters memorable.

item.title: 3 arrested in shooting death of 17-year-old at Hanford apartment complex, police say
item.description: Three people were arrested in Southern California for the shooting death of a 17-year-old in Hanford on Friday.

item.title: Woman livestreams detainment as federal agents smash car window in SoCal: 'Lord, please protect me'
item.description: A woman who livestreamed her detainment by federal immigration agents is speaking publicly after she was released from custody Friday evening, describing the encounter as frightening and traumatic.

item.title: 'Sanford and Son' star Demond Wilson dies at 79 after battle with cancer, son says
item.description: The entertainment world is mourning the loss of 70's TV star Demond Wilson, who was most known for his role opposite Redd Foxx in the hit series, "Sanford and Son."

item.title: Drivers recount being stuck in 59-vehicle pileup on Highway 99 in Tulare County
item.description: Katrina Saldivar was among those caught behind the 59-vehicle pileup on Highway 99 in Tulare County. She said she realized something was wrong when traffic suddenly came to a stop.

item.title: Highway 99 in Tulare County reopens after 59-vehicle pileup, CHP says
item.description: Highway 99 in Tulare County has reopened after a 59-vehicle pile-up forced a total closure Saturday morning near Earlimart.

item.title: Video captures chaos inside 59-vehicle pileup on Highway 99 in Tulare County
item.description: A woman and her mother were injured after becoming trapped in the massive 59-car pileup on Highway 99 early Saturday morning while traveling from Oxnard to the Central Valley.
